request.system:
You are shown the catalogue of an online shop: its name, country and products, with the checked facts we hold about each product. Draft a short store profile that the shop owner will read and correct.

- sells: two or three plain sentences on what the shop sells, by kind of product, as the catalogue shows it.
- audience: one or two sentences on who buys it, only as far as the products themselves show. Do not invent ages, incomes or lifestyles.
- tone: the voice that suits this catalogue for articles: "plain", "friendly" or "expert".

Use only what the catalogue shows. Write in English.

messages.content:
<shop>Fernhill Coffee Supply</shop>
<country>GB</country>
<products>
- Ceramic Cone Dripper, size 02 (Dripper) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is size 02.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is a dripper.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper is made by Fernhill.
    - The Ceramic Cone Dripper comes in White and Matte black.
- Flat-Bottom Dripper, stainless steel (Dripper) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper is made of stainless steel.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper is made by Fernhill.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper has a brushed 18/8 stainless steel body.
    - The Flat-Bottom Dripper has three small holes in a flat bed.
- Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle 900 ml (Kettle) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a capacity of 900 ml.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a recommended fill of 600 ml.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a spout opening of 8 mm.
    - The Fernhill Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle has a built-in thermometer reading 40–100 °C.
- Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold (Kettle) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold lets you set the temperature in 1 °C steps from 60 to 100 °C.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold base holds the set temperature for 60 minutes.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has an 800 ml capacity.
    - The Electric Gooseneck Kettle with Temperature Hold has a 1200 W heating element.
- Hand Grinder, conical steel burrs (Grinder) — Grinders
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has conical steel burrs.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder is a manual grinder.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has 38 mm hardened stainless steel conical burrs.
    - The Fernhill Hand Grinder has external click adjustment with 30 settings.
- Electric Flat-Burr Grinder (Grinder) — Grinders
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has 64 mm flat steel burrs.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has stepless adjustment.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has a single-dose design.
    - The Electric Flat-Burr Grinder has retention under 0.1 g.
- French Press 1 litre (Immersion brewer) — Immersion brewers
    - The French Press has a capacity of 1 litre.
    - The French Press is an immersion brewer.
    - The French Press is made by Fernhill.
    - The French Press has a borosilicate glass beaker.
- Cold Brew Jar 1.5 litre (Immersion brewer) — Immersion brewers
    - The Cold Brew Jar has a capacity of 1.5 litre.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is an immersion brewer.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is made by Fernhill.
    - The Cold Brew Jar is a glass jar.
- Ethiopia Guji, natural process (Coffee beans) — Coffee beans
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is coffee beans.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is sold by Fernhill Roastery.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available in 250 g and 1 kg sizes.
    - Ethiopia Guji, natural process is available as whole bean, filter grind, or espresso grind.
- Colombia Huila, washed (Coffee beans) — Coffee beans
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is washed-process.
    - The Colombia Huila product is coffee beans.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee is from Fernhill Roastery.
    - The Colombia Huila coffee comes in 250 g and 1 kg sizes.
- Paper Filters, size 02 (100 pack) (Filter) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are size 02.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters come in a pack of 100.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are available in Unbleached and White types.
    - The Fernhill Paper Filters are cone filters for size 02 drippers.
- Brew Scale with Timer (Scale) — Pour-over brewing
    - The Brew Scale with Timer weighs up to 2 kg.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer weighs in 0.1 g steps.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer has a built-in timer that starts automatically when the first drops land.
    - The Brew Scale with Timer has a USB-C rechargeable battery.
</products>

content.text: {"sells":"Fernhill Coffee Supply sells home coffee brewing equipment and coffee beans. The range covers pour-over gear (ceramic and stainless steel drippers, size 02 paper filters, stovetop and electric gooseneck kettles, and a brew scale with timer), immersion brewers such as a French press and a cold brew jar, and manual and electric burr grinders. It also sells single-origin coffee beans from Fernhill Roastery in 250 g and 1 kg bags, whole bean or ground.","audience":"People who brew coffee at home, especially by pour-over or immersion, and who want to grind, weigh and control water temperature themselves. Some products, such as the single-dose flat-burr grinder and the temperature-hold kettle, suit buyers who care about precise brewing.","tone":"expert"}
